verses.kjv: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

verses.web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.kjv: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

verses.web: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
verses.kjv: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

verses.web: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.kjv: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.web: The porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
verses.kjv: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

verses.web: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward: they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.
verses.kjv: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

verses.web: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent: and their fathers had been over the camp of Yahweh, keepers of the entry.
verses.kjv: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.

verses.web: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.
verses.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.

verses.web: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
verses.kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.web: All these who were chosen to be porters in the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
verses.kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

verses.web: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, by wards.
verses.kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

verses.web: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

verses.web: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
verses.kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

verses.web: for the four chief porters, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
verses.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

verses.web: They lodged around God’s house, because that duty was on them; and to them pertained its opening morning by morning.
verses.kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

verses.web: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service; for by count were these brought in and by count were these taken out.
verses.kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

verses.web: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.web: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.
verses.kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

verses.web: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

verses.web: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
verses.kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

verses.web: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service; for they were employed in their work day and night.
verses.kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

verses.web: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men: these lived at Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

verses.web: In Gibeon there lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah:
verses.kjv: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:

verses.web: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

verses.web: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, over against their brothers.
verses.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

verses.web: Ner became the father of Kish; and Kish became the father of Saul; and Saul became the father of Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.kjv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.

verses.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal; and Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
verses.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal: and Merib–baal begat Micah.

verses.web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.

verses.web: Ahaz became the father of Jarah; and Jarah became the father of Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza;
verses.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

verses.web: and Moza became the father of Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.kjv: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

verses.web: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
verses.kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.web: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
verses.kjv: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi–shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.web: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.
verses.kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

verses.web: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not; for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword, and fell on it.
verses.kjv: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.web: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died.
verses.kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

verses.web: So Saul died, and his three sons; and all his house died together.
verses.kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

verses.web: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
verses.kjv: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.web: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.web: They stripped him, and took his head, and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to their idols, and to the people.
verses.kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

verses.web: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.
verses.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.web: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.kjv: And when all Jabesh–gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.web: all the valiant men arose, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.kjv: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.web: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against Yahweh, because of Yahweh’s word, which he didn’t keep; and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,
verses.kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

verses.web: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh: therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.
verses.kjv: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

verses.web: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.kjv: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

verses.web: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. Yahweh your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”
verses.kjv: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

verses.web: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to Yahweh’s word by Samuel.
verses.kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

verses.web: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (the same is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
verses.kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

verses.web: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You shall not come in here.” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is the city of David.
verses.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

verses.web: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.
verses.kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

verses.web: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.web: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.web: David grew greater and greater; for Yahweh of Armies was with him.
verses.kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.

verses.web: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to Yahweh’s word concerning Israel.
verses.kjv: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

verses.web: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
verses.kjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

verses.web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
verses.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

verses.web: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.kjv: He was with David at Pas–dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

verses.web: They stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh saved them by a great victory.
verses.kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.

verses.web: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.kjv: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.web: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
verses.kjv: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth–lehem.

verses.web: David longed, and said, “Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
verses.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth–lehem, that is at the gate!

verses.web: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh,
verses.kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth–lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,

verses.web: and said, “My God forbid it me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
verses.kjv: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

verses.web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
verses.kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

verses.web: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain: however he didn’t attain to the three.
verses.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

verses.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down also and killed a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
verses.kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

verses.web: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

verses.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
verses.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

verses.web: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

verses.web: Also the mighty men of the armies: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
verses.kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth–lehem,

verses.web: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.web: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
verses.kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi–ezer the Antothite,

verses.web: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.web: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.web: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.web: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.web: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.web: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,
verses.kjv: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

verses.web: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

verses.web: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.web: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

verses.web: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,
verses.kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

verses.web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.web: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.web: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

verses.web: Hanan the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.web: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
verses.kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

verses.web: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

verses.web: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.web: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

verses.web: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish; and they were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.
verses.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

verses.web: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow: they were of Saul’s brothers of Benjamin.
verses.kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

verses.web: The chief was Ahiezer; then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite, and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth, and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite,
verses.kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

verses.web: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty, and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite,
verses.kjv: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

verses.web: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.kjv: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

verses.web: Elkanah, and Isshiah, and Azarel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites,
verses.kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

verses.web: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

verses.web: Of the Gadites there separated themselves to David to the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, that could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the roes on the mountains;
verses.kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

verses.web: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

verses.web: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.web: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.web: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.web: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

verses.web: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army: he who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
verses.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

verses.web: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

verses.web: There came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the stronghold to David.
verses.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

verses.web: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit to you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”
verses.kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

verses.web: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

verses.web: Of Manasseh also there fell away some to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle; but they didn’t help them; for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will fall away to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”
verses.kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

verses.web: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.
verses.kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

verses.web: They helped David against the band of rovers: for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the army.
verses.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

verses.web: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like the army of God.
verses.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

verses.web: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to Yahweh’s word.
verses.kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

verses.web: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.
verses.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

verses.web: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

verses.web: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

verses.web: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand and seven hundred,
verses.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

verses.web: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.
verses.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

verses.web: Of the children of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to the house of Saul.
verses.kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

verses.web: Of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
verses.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

verses.web: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
verses.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

verses.web: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their commandment.
verses.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

verses.web: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array, with all kinds of instruments of war, fifty thousand, and who could command and were not of double heart.
verses.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

verses.web: Of Naphtali one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.
verses.kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

verses.web: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array, twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
verses.kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

verses.web: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array, forty thousand.
verses.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

verses.web: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle, one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

verses.web: All these being men of war, who could order the battle array, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

verses.web: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had made preparation for them.
verses.kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

verses.web: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, food of meal, cakes of figs, and clusters of raisins, and wine, and oil, and cattle, and sheep in abundance: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

verses.web: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
verses.kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

verses.web: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let us send abroad everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have suburbs, that they may gather themselves to us;
verses.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

verses.web: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us. For we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
verses.kjv: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

verses.web: All the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.web: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.
verses.kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim.

verses.web: David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God Yahweh that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
verses.kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath–jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

verses.web: They carried the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
verses.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

verses.web: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, and with harps, and with stringed instruments, and with tambourines, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

verses.web: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

verses.web: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put out his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
verses.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

verses.web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
verses.kjv: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day.

verses.web: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?”
verses.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

verses.web: So David didn’t move the ark to him into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
verses.kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite.

verses.web: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months: and Yahweh blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he had.
verses.kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed–edom, and all that he had.

verses.web: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
verses.kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

verses.web: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel; for his kingdom was exalted on high, for his people Israel’s sake.
verses.kjv: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

verses.web: David took more wives at Jerusalem; and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.kjv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

verses.web: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.kjv: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.web: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpelet,
verses.kjv: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

verses.web: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.web: and Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
verses.kjv: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.web: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David: and David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.kjv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

verses.web: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.kjv: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.web: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”
verses.kjv: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

verses.web: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there; and David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like the breach of waters. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
verses.kjv: So they came up to Baal–perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal–perazim.

verses.web: They left their gods there; and David gave commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

verses.web: The Philistines yet again made a raid in the valley.
verses.kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

verses.web: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.kjv: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.web: It shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”
verses.kjv: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.web: David did as God commanded him: and they struck the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.
verses.kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

verses.web: The fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahweh brought the fear of him on all nations.
verses.kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.

verses.web: David made him houses in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

verses.web: Then David said, “No one ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry the ark of God, and to minister to him forever.”
verses.kjv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

verses.web: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.kjv: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

verses.web: David gathered together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.kjv: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

verses.web: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

verses.web: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

verses.web: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

verses.web: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

verses.web: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

verses.web: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

verses.web: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.kjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

verses.web: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

verses.web: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
verses.kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

verses.web: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verses.kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.

verses.web: The children of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders with the its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.
verses.kjv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.

verses.web: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers the singers, with instruments of music, stringed instruments and harps and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

verses.web: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

verses.web: and with them their brothers of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.kjv: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

verses.web: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
verses.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

verses.web: and Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
verses.kjv: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

verses.web: and Mattithiah, and Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

verses.web: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the song: he instructed about the song, because he was skillful.
verses.kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

verses.web: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.kjv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.web: Shebaniah, and Joshaphat, and Nethanel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed–edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.web: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.kjv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obed–edom with joy.

verses.web: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.web: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites who bore the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: and David had on him an ephod of linen.
verses.kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

verses.web: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahweh with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
verses.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

verses.web: As the ark of the covenant of Yahweh came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

verses.web: They brought in the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

verses.web: When David had made an end of offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
verses.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

verses.web: He dealt to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
verses.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

verses.web: He appointed certain of the Levites to minister before Yahweh’s ark, and to celebrate and to thank and praise Yahweh, the God of Israel:
verses.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:

verses.web: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
verses.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed–edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

verses.web: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.web: Then on that day David first ordained to give thanks to Yahweh, by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
verses.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

verses.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make his doings known among the peoples.
verses.kjv: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

verses.web: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
verses.kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.

verses.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.web: you seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.web: He is Yahweh our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.kjv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.web: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.
verses.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

verses.web: He confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

verses.web: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”
verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

verses.web: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners were in it.
verses.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

verses.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
verses.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

verses.web: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.web: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

verses.web: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

verses.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.kjv: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

verses.web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
verses.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

verses.web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you relatives of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!
verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

verses.web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship Yahweh in holy array.
verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.web: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
verses.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

verses.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
verses.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.

verses.web: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is therein!
verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

verses.web: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.
verses.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.

verses.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.web: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
verses.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh.
verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.

verses.web: So he left there, before the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
verses.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

verses.web: and Obed-Edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
verses.kjv: And Obed–edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

verses.web: and Zadok the priest, and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,

verses.web: to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in Yahweh’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
verses.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;

verses.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to Yahweh, because his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.web: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

verses.web: All the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

verses.web: When David lived in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of Yahweh is under curtains.”
verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

verses.web: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
verses.kjv: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

verses.web: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.web: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
verses.kjv: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

verses.web: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel, to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.
verses.kjv: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

verses.web: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
verses.kjv: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

verses.web: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘Thus says Yahweh of Armies, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, that you should be prince over my people Israel.
verses.kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

verses.web: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.
verses.kjv: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.web: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the first,
verses.kjv: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

verses.web: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel; and I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that Yahweh will build you a house.
verses.kjv: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.

verses.web: It shall happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your seed after you, who shall be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.web: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.kjv: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

verses.web: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him that was before you;
verses.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

verses.web: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne shall be established forever.”’”
verses.kjv: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

verses.web: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
verses.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.web: Then David the king went in, and sat before Yahweh; and he said, “Who am I, Yahweh God, and what is my house, that you have brought me thus far?
verses.kjv: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

verses.web: This was a small thing in your eyes, God; but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the estate of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.
verses.kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

verses.web: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.
verses.kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

verses.web: Yahweh, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have worked all this greatness, to make known all these great things.
verses.kjv: O Lord, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

verses.web: Yahweh, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.kjv: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.web: What one nation in the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeem out of Egypt?
verses.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

verses.web: For your people Israel you made your own people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
verses.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.

verses.web: Now, Yahweh, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.
verses.kjv: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

verses.web: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’
verses.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

verses.web: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
verses.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

verses.web: Now, Yahweh, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.
verses.kjv: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

verses.web: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, Yahweh, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”
verses.kjv: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.

verses.web: After this, David struck the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.web: He struck Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.web: David struck Hadadezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

verses.web: David took from him one thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

verses.web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck of the Syrians twenty-two thousand men.
verses.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.web: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much brass, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

verses.web: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
verses.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

verses.web: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to Greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou;) and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.kjv: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

verses.web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.web: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt eighteen thousand.
verses.kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

verses.web: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.web: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness to all his people.
verses.kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

verses.web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

verses.web: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

verses.web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

verses.web: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

verses.web: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.kjv: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

verses.web: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”
verses.kjv: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

verses.web: So Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.web: Then there went certain persons, and told David how the men were served. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly ashamed. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”
verses.kjv: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.web: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Arammaacah, and out of Zobah.
verses.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria–maachah, and out of Zobah.

verses.web: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.kjv: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

verses.web: When David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the army of the mighty men.
verses.kjv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.web: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city: and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
verses.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

verses.web: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
